content: Skip-gram with negative sampling (SGNS) BIBREF0 and GloVe BIBREF1 are among the best known models for generating static word embeddings. Though they learn embeddings iteratively in practice, it has been proven that in theory, they both implicitly factorize a word-context matrix containing a co-occurrence statistic BIBREF7, BIBREF8. Because they create a single representation for each word, a notable problem with static word embeddings is that all senses of a polysemous word must share a single vector.
